unlisted_practices: Using item response theory-based computerized adaptive testing to cheaply and repeatedly benchmark LLM medical knowledge for pre-screening and continuous monitoring

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an adaptive testing protocol (CAT) for continuous evaluation and pre-screening of LLMs on standardized medical knowledge benchmarks, assessing its efficiency and rank preservation compared to full benchmark evaluation.

primary.practice: computerized adaptive testing for continuous monitoring and pre-screening
